title: Figures 2–3: Optical Camouflage, Tachi Laboratory, Tokyo – cloak photo and diagram
description: Color photograph of a man wearing a retroreflective "invisibility cloak" onto which the background, a colorful pop-art poster, is projected, so his torso appears see-through ("Figure 2. Optical Camouflage (Tachi Laboratory, Tokyo)"). Below is an explanatory illustration titled "The Secret of Transparent Cloak" with numbered parts: camera, computer, projector, peephole, half mirror, cloak and real scene. It is captioned "Figure 3. The Secret Optical Camouflage (Tachi Laboratory, Tokyo)."
